subject.title: test(repair): add hermetic automerge end-to-end flow

question: Should this repository permanently run the new same-repository, root-outer-container automerge E2E workflow on the Blacksmith runner to exercise the nested production containment path?
rationale: The patch fixes the prior supply-chain ownership concern, but accepting its runner trust boundary, root outer-container requirement, and recurring CI cost is an operational policy choice rather than a mechanical code correction.

options.title: Approve the contained E2E boundary
options.body: Accept the repository-built image, read-only token model, fork exclusion, and root outer container as the supported way to exercise production containment.

options.title: Require a narrower execution model
options.body: Keep the harness but request a reduced-runner or alternate containment design before enabling the workflow on normal same-repository pull requests.

options.title: Defer the workflow
options.body: Keep the harness draft until a repair/workflow owner explicitly sponsors the additional CI cost and trust boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the contained E2E boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the repository-built image, read-only token model, fork exclusion, and root outer container as the supported way to exercise production containment.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows this member carrying the related automerge runtime and harness changes, making them the best available routing candidate for the implementation details.
